resources.string: Find a user to end their sessions, for example after a lost phone. The server logs every action with your ID.
This is a bot: bots have no sessions.
No sessions: the user is signed out everywhere.

The device is signed out at once. Its encryption device is removed as well: it can no longer read encrypted chats, and messages only it had keys for stay unreadable unless the user has a key backup or another verified device.
This includes this device: you will be signed out.
You are not an administrator of this server.
The server did not answer. Try again.
Admin mode is off. Admin actions need two-factor authentication, valid for an hour on this device.
Admin mode is off: turn it on with your authenticator code.
Admin mode needs an authenticator app. Turn it on in Settings → Account → Two-factor authentication first.
The code was wrong or expired. Turn admin mode on again with a new code.
